title: Platform Regulatory Assurance Manager
searchText: Platform Regulatory Assurance Manager  Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . As the Platform Regulatory Assurance Manager, you will be the primary architect and executor of our internal assurance program for global platform regulations. Reporting to the Director of Business Risk within the Internal Audit team, you will play a pivotal role in providing independent monitoring and assurance for global platform regulations. You will be responsible for advising on the design, documenting, and testing robust internal controls while serving as the strategic "white glove" liaison for external regulatory assessments. Your mission is to provide high-touch support across the organization, ensuring that complex legislative requirements are translated into seamless, audit-ready operational realities. What you’ll do Design and implement scalable assurance frameworks designed to satisfy the most rigorous standards of global regulatory scrutiny. Translate abstract legislative requirements into concrete, defensible processes and controls that withstand intensive regulator examination. Act as a dedicated advisor to cross-functional partners, providing "white glove" education and support to ensure stakeholders deeply understand regulatory requirements and control expectations and trends in regulatory expectations. Proactively identify gaps in platform risk management and partner with Legal, Trust & Safety Policy, Engineering, Privacy, and Product teams to develop and oversee strategic remediation plans. Serve as the primary point of contact and lead facilitator for mandatory external audits and third-party assessments required by global regulators. Monitor the evolving landscape of internet regulations to ensure our global assurance framework remains robust and future-proof. Leverage advanced audit techniques and evangelize a "common-controls" approach to maximize risk coverage and compliance efficiency. Who You Might Be An experienced professional with 5+ years in Internal Audit, Regulatory Compliance, or Risk Management, specifically within the tech or online platform industry. A subject matter expert with experience supporting internal advisory and assurance workstreams for platform regulations such as the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act. A collaborative leader and proactive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. A clear and persuasive communicator capable of distilling complex regulatory mandates into digestible, actionable guidance for diverse business functions. Professional certifications such as CIA, CISA or CIPP/E are preferred. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Knowledge of global privacy and internet-related regulations (e.g., UK OSA, EU DSA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) and their operational impact on platform technology. Solid grasp of platform governance concepts and the ability to translate business objectives into technical compliance solutions. Strong project management skills with a proven ability to oversee large-scale, multi-month audit cycles involving global stakeholders. A "first-principles" thinker with the ability to build frameworks for emerging laws where no established industry blueprint yet exists. Proven ability to use data and critical thinking to validate control effectiveness and generate insights that solve complex business problems. Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $154,700 — $216,600 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.
